Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
 Order

This petition has been filed for cancellation of the anticipatory bail granted to the accused Mohit Gupta @ Monu by this Court vide order dated 02nd November, 2022 in FIR No. 301/2019 under Sections 376/506 IPC.

The case was registered on the basis of a complaint of the prosecutrix who is the sister in-law of the accused i.e. wife of the brother of the accused and had apparently tried to establish sexual relationship with her.
While granting anticipatory bail, this Court had made it subject to the conditions including "not to indulge in any criminal or illegal activity" during that period.

2. It is now transpires that that the pursuant to the said order, the accused has again outraged the modesty of the petitioner in public and a written complaint in that regard was filed which was later registered as FIR No. 206/2023 under Sections 354/323/341/506/34 IPC PS Jaitpur.
3. This petition has been moved for cancellation of anticipatory bail considering these continued illegal activities of the accused.
4. Issue notice.
Learned APP accepts notice.
Status Report will be filed which would also indicate the current status of the FIR 206/2023.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/09/2023 at 21:44:35 5.
Ld. APP states on instruction that charge sheet is to be filed very soon in that regard.

6. Notice may also be issued to respondent No. 2 on steps being taken by the petitioner through all permissible modes including PF/RC, courier, SMS, Whatsapp, email etc.

1 7.

In the meantime, if there is any further attempt by accused to outrage the modesty, assault or inflict any harm of the petitioner, she will be at liberty to approach the beat constable and the SHO whose numbers have been provided to her by Ld. APP for the State.

8. List on 02nd August, 2023.
9.
Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
ANISH DAYAL, J MAY 22, 2023/RK
